map.依据痰涂片、培养及一线/二线药敏结果，分析耐药结核类型并提示治疗方案方向: Analyzes the drug-resistant TB type from sputum smear, culture and first/second-line susceptibility results, and indicates treatment direction

map.结核耐药分型：无利福平及异烟肼耐药为药物敏感结核 DS-TB（2HRZE/4HR: TB resistance typing: no rifampicin or isoniazid resistance is drug-susceptible TB (DS-TB, 2HRZE/4HR); rifampicin resistance is RR-TB; with isoniazid resistance too it is MDR-TB; plus fluoroquinolone and second-line injectable resistance is XDR-TB - the regimen follows the resistance pattern.
map.至少耐INH+RIF: Resistant to at least INH + RIF
map.含贝达喹啉的短程或长程方案: Short or long regimen including bedaquiline
map.MDR/RR + 耐氟喹诺酮 或 二线注射剂: MDR/RR plus fluoroquinolone or second-line injectable resistance
map.MDR/RR + 耐氟喹诺酮 + 耐至少一种二线注射剂: MDR/RR plus fluoroquinolone resistance plus resistance to at least one second-line injectable
map.个体化长程方案，多学科会诊: Individualized long regimen with multidisciplinary review
map.提示：涂片阳性提示传染性强，需呼吸道隔离。GeneXpert利福平耐药需经表型药: Note: smear positivity indicates high infectivity and requires respiratory isolation. GeneXpert rifampicin resistance must be confirmed by phenotypic susceptibility. BPaL/BPaLM (bedaquiline + pretomanid + linezolid +/- moxifloxacin) suits MDR/RR-TB patients aged >=6 without fluoroquinolone or injectable resistance. Clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：结核耐药分析: 📚 Deep Dive: TB Drug Resistance Analysis
map.涂片阳性且有传染；Xpert 报利福平耐药→RR-TB，按耐药流程隔离治疗。: Smear positive and infectious; Xpert reports rifampicin resistance -> RR-TB, isolate and treat per the drug-resistant pathway.
map.涂片阴性+培养阴性→传染性低，仍完成疗程并复查。: Smear negative + culture negative -> low infectivity, but still complete the course and recheck.
map.RR-TB 含利福平耐药(含 MDR)，治疗以全口服短程方案为主。: RR-TB covers rifampicin resistance (including MDR); treatment is mainly all-oral short regimens.
map.涂片阴转并治疗 2 周后传染性大幅下降，遵医嘱解隔。: After smear conversion and 2 weeks of treatment infectivity drops sharply; de-isolate per medical advice.
